title: A Windy Day
lines: It was a windy, sunny day in May.
Tom had a new kite with a long tail.
He took it up the rocky hill by the farm.
Mom sat on a rock to watch him.
Tom ran fast and the kite went up high.
It went up and up. Tom was happy.
Then the wind took the kite away.
It got stuck up in a tall green tree.
The string hung down but it was too high.
Tom felt sad as he looked up at it.
He jumped up at the string three times.
But he was much too small to reach it.
Then he got a box and stood on top.
The box did not hold him. He got down.
Tom ran back to the shed for a rake.
Mom held the rake up next to him.
Tom hooked the string and gave it a tug.
The kite fell down into the long grass.
It was muddy but it did not rip.
"You got that," said Mom. Tom just grins.

questions.ask: Where did the kite get stuck?
questions.listenFor: Up in a tall green tree, with the string hanging down. Lines eight and nine.

questions.ask: What did Tom try first, and what worked in the end?
questions.listenFor: He jumped three times, then stood on a box. The rake worked, with Mom holding it up next to him.

questions.ask: How do you think Tom felt at the end? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine, as long as they point to something in the story.
